name: Car Roof Backflip AI Video: You Flip From One Car to the Next
blurb: The car roof backflip AI video puts you into the trend's highway clip: you climb out through the roof of a black SUV, stand up, backflip across the gap between two moving cars and land feet first on a red hatchback's roof.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Use the reference video [Video 1] for the scene, vehicles, timing, jump trajectory, and camera movement. Replace the stunt performer throughout with the adult person in [Image 1], including airborne and back-facing views. Follow the preparation, takeoff, one backward somersault, and feet-first landing on the second roof. Keep both cars upright and consistent. No identity changes, teleportation, extra limbs, or hidden landing.

Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: a rear-view, wide-angle cinematic shot on a wide highway under an overcast sky. A black SUV driving on the left lane and a red hatchback driving parallel on the right lane at medium speed. A young man emerges from the roof of the black SUV, stands up, and performs a dramatic acrobatic backflip through the air across the gap between the vehicles, successfully landing on top of the roof of the red hatchback. Photorealistic, high-octane action sequence, realistic lighting and the same camera tracking behind the cars as in [Video 1]: the same framing, timing and moves, one continuous shot with no cuts. The ONLY change: the young man is now the person in [Image 1].

The stunt performer = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. They wear the clothes from [Image 1]; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them: while climbing out of the roof, standing on the black SUV, upside down in the air and crouching on the red hatchback at the end. Never morph, never drift back to the original young man's face, never add or remove facial hair. NO sunglasses: no glasses of any kind unless [Image 1] shows glasses. No black t-shirt, no light-blue jeans and no white sneakers unless [Image 1] shows them.

The two cars stay as in [Video 1]: the matte black boxy SUV with the spare wheel on its tailgate in the left lane and the red hatchback in the right lane, side by side at the same steady speed with the same gap, both upright the whole time. No badges, emblems, model names or lettering on either car and no readable number plates.

The moves, matching the reference second by second:
0-1.8 s: climbs up out of the black SUV's roof and crouches on top of it, holding on.
1.8-3.0 s: stands up on the roof, knees bent, balancing, and looks across at the red hatchback.
3.0-3.8 s: swings both arms back, then forward, and pushes off the SUV's roof.
3.8-8.2 s: one slow backward somersault high above the gap between the cars: the body arches back, goes horizontal, tucks the knees, turns upside down at the top and comes around over the red hatchback.
8.2-10 s: lands feet first on the red hatchback's roof in a low crouch, hands near the roof, and stays there, balanced, while both cars drive on.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the performer's own shoulders. Two arms, two hands and two legs, also upside down in the air. Exactly one backward somersault and a landing you can see. Nobody else on the cars. No text, no logos, no watermark, no extra people.
